title: Plumeform answer-type chooser band
description: A near-black green band: bold heading and a long paragraph side by side, then labelled groups of outlined pill chips (one selected in mint) beside a glass demo card with two offset cards stacked behind it, back and next controls and a counter, then the complete list in five columns with tier tags. Rises in as it scrolls; chips brighten on hover.
notes: the demo card is a media slot (the original runs a live example per type); the chips and controls are static
